name: Tempoross

mechanics.name: Water Torrent
mechanics.description: It casts a torrent that douses the fires under the cannons and soaks anyone standing in the way.
mechanics.counterplay: Get out of the marked water and relight the fire once it passes.

mechanics.name: Lightning Clouds
mechanics.description: Storm clouds gather over parts of the deck, grow, and then discharge onto whatever is underneath.
mechanics.counterplay: Watch the shadow on the deck and move before it charges. There is plenty of warning.

mechanics.name: Tether
mechanics.description: It hurls a wave at the ships. Anything not tied down goes overboard with it.
mechanics.counterplay: Tether to the mast when the warning appears and stay tethered until the wave has passed.

mechanics.name: Spirit Pool and Cannons
mechanics.description: It surfaces at a spirit pool to be attacked directly, and the cannons are what actually damage it. Cannons jam and their fires go out.
mechanics.counterplay: Load and fire the cannons rather than attacking it yourself, and keep their fires lit.

_note: SKELETON, NOT LIVE-VERIFIED. Ids come from Jagex's own gameval names rather than guesses, but nothing here has been confirmed in a live fight. Provenance: gamevals from runelite-api 1.12.35 (net.runelite.api.gameval.*), because this cache download ships an empty GAMEVALS index (idx24) and ScanGameVal cannot read it; npc names, models, sequences and extents from the live cache (revision of 2026-08-06). Npc id 6257. Unlike Wintertodt on the same tab, this boss does exist as an npc, which is why this file has a real npcIds and animation triggers rather than a workaround. Animations are the TEMPOROSS_* set, all unambiguous gameval names: TORRENT 8882 and TORRENT_CAST 8893, the four LIGHTNING_CLOUD sequences 8876 through 8879, TETHER 8868 with TETHER_LOOP 8869 and UNTETHER 8870, and the cannon sequences 8871, 8872, 8883 and 8884. THE CANNON AND CLOUD ANIMATIONS ARE ALMOST CERTAINLY PLAYED BY SCENERY, NOT BY THE BOSS, which is this file's main weakness. An animation trigger only matches when played by an npc the engine is currently tracking as this boss (docs/DECISIONS.md D17), so if the cannons and clouds are objects rather than npcs, those three mechanics will never unlock. They are curated anyway rather than left out, because the gameval names are unambiguous and the cost of being wrong is a mechanic that stays locked rather than one that false-positives. The torrent is the safest of the four, being the one thing the boss visibly does itself. No projectile is curated: TEMPOROSS_STORM_CLOUD_LIGHTNING_SPOTANIM 8874 is a graphic by name, and no TEMPOROSS spotanim carries an unambiguous projectile suffix. THE TORRENT PREVIEW SHIPS AT ZOOM 6578, THE LARGEST IN THE PLUGIN BY A WIDE MARGIN. TEMPOROSS_TORRENT_CAST 8893 sweeps the model enormously further than its own idle footprint, so the fit has to pull right back to contain it. The other three previews use the idle at zoom 2313, close to struct 3586's own 2800, so the difference between them will be visible when switching rows. staticFallback is false on all four; whether each body animation reads has not been eyeballed in game. The collection log page is titled 'Tempoross', matching 'name'.
